entries.definition: to plan the details of something
entries.example: Could you arrange a short meeting for Friday?

entries.definition: a planned meeting at a particular time
entries.example: My appointment with the dentist is at noon.

entries.definition: an arrangement to keep a place for you
entries.example: We made a reservation at a small restaurant.

entries.definition: free to use or able to meet
entries.example: Is the meeting room available this afternoon?

entries.definition: to say that an arrangement is certain
entries.example: Please confirm your arrival time by email.

entries.definition: to decide that a planned event will not happen
entries.example: Heavy snow forced us to cancel the trip.

entries.definition: a polite act of asking for something
entries.example: The librarian accepted my request for another week.

entries.definition: to answer a message or question
entries.example: I will reply after I check the schedule.

entries.definition: to refer to something without much detail
entries.example: Please mention the entrance fee in your message.

entries.definition: to make something easier to understand
entries.example: Can you explain why this ticket costs more?

entries.definition: to offer an idea for someone to consider
entries.example: I suggest taking the earlier bus tomorrow.

entries.definition: to say that something is a good choice
entries.example: Which local café would you recommend for lunch?

entries.definition: agreement that allows someone to do something
entries.example: Ask for permission before taking a photograph.

entries.definition: to say that you are sorry
entries.example: I should apologize for sending the wrong address.

entries.definition: a statement that something is wrong or unsatisfactory
entries.example: Her complaint concerned the broken elevator.

entries.definition: showing respect for other people
entries.example: A polite request usually gets a helpful response.

entries.definition: speaking or acting without respect
entries.example: It is rude to interrupt someone repeatedly.

entries.definition: to stop someone while they are speaking
entries.example: Please do not interrupt while Sara explains the route.

entries.definition: to understand someone or something incorrectly
entries.example: You might misunderstand the joke without its context.

entries.definition: to make a meaning or detail clearer
entries.example: Could you clarify which entrance we should use?

entries.definition: to help someone remember something
entries.example: Please remind me to return your umbrella.

entries.definition: to say firmly that you will do something
entries.example: I promise to call when the train arrives.

entries.definition: to ask someone to attend or join something
entries.example: Let us invite our neighbors to dinner.

entries.definition: to say that you will not accept or do something
entries.example: You can refuse an invitation without being unkind.

entries.definition: to agree to receive or take something
entries.example: She decided to accept the offer of help.

entries.definition: to like one choice more than another
entries.example: I prefer a quiet table near the window.

entries.definition: in place of another person or thing
entries.example: The café was closed, so we cooked instead.

entries.definition: if that does not happen
entries.example: Leave before eight; otherwise, you may miss the bus.

entries.definition: used when something is possible but uncertain
entries.example: Perhaps we can meet after your class.

entries.definition: used when something is likely to happen
entries.example: The next train will probably be less crowded.

entries.definition: used to express strong agreement or confidence
entries.example: I can certainly help you carry that box.

entries.definition: used to introduce disappointing news
entries.example: Unfortunately, the library closes early on Saturdays.

entries.definition: used to introduce a good or helpful fact
entries.example: Fortunately, a neighbor had a spare key.

entries.definition: more than usual or more than others
entries.example: The park is especially quiet before breakfast.

entries.definition: used to correct an idea or add the real fact
entries.example: The shop is actually beside the station, not inside it.

entries.definition: despite what has just been said
entries.example: It might rain, but we will walk anyway.

entries.definition: used to connect two contrasting ideas
entries.example: Although the room was small, everyone felt welcome.

entries.definition: except if a particular thing happens
entries.example: We will wait outside unless it starts raining.

entries.definition: used to introduce two possible situations
entries.example: Please tell me whether you need a receipt.

entries.definition: during the time that something else happens
entries.example: The soup is cooking; meanwhile, we can set the table.

entries.definition: an informal exchange of spoken ideas
entries.example: Our conversation continued long after the café closed.

entries.definition: words or actions used when meeting someone
entries.example: A friendly greeting helped the new student relax.

entries.definition: a movement that expresses an idea or feeling
entries.example: His gesture showed us where to sit.

entries.definition: a group of words with a particular meaning
entries.example: The expression “no worries” can show friendly reassurance.

entries.definition: a particular way of pronouncing a language
entries.example: Her accent reflects several places where she has lived.

entries.definition: to make the sounds of a word
entries.example: How do you pronounce the name of this street?

entries.definition: to say or do something again
entries.example: Could you repeat the last part more slowly?

entries.definition: to say or do something as an answer
entries.example: Please respond to the invitation by Thursday.

entries.definition: to do something one person after another
entries.example: During the discussion, we take turns speaking.

entries.definition: to continue communicating with someone
entries.example: We plan to keep in touch after graduation.
